result.scope: independent integer model; q2 exact-column union; no C++ qualification, large census, timing, WSPD, FULL or tower claim

limits: The maximum-only countermodel is safe but weaker; the other three countermodels can falsely reject q2 candidates.
Large complete-grid counts use descriptor masses and a finite offset formula, not a geometric census of their full Cartesian products.
No port to C++, elapsed-time claim, generic linear query bound, WSPD, q3/q4, FULL or tower qualification.
Axis populations are disjoint only for exact columns through the same anchor with the anchor excluded; the credit cannot be added to arbitrary tube credits without accounting for shared IDs.
Complete-grid candidate formulas do not automatically extend to truncated sheets or rotated point clouds.

This model uses binary searches over whole exact columns, O(log m) per count. Restriction to at most h ranks on each side and O(log h) queries is a proposed implementation improvement, not executed here.
